subagents.purpose: Checks Supabase agent_requests table for answered requests addressed to Legal Agent. Fetches Active Broadcast Directives from Notion and processes inter-agent messages. Designed to run on a schedule (9:00, 13:00, 17:00 Brussels time Mon-Fri).

Performs true recursive scanning of all Google Drive legal folders (Funding, Governance, Subsidies, Tax/Compliance, Steekproef). Downloads and extracts full text from all PDFs/DOCX and inserts into Supabase Legal_Documents, Subsidy_Contracts, and Tax_Compliance_Docs tables. Skips duplicates.
Parses individual legal documents from Google Drive (PDF/DOCX), extracts metadata and full content, and prepares structured insert payloads for Supabase.
Uploads a specific new contract (Deal Advisor dienstenovereenkomst) to Supabase Legal_Documents table with full content extraction from a local PDF file.
Fixes the Vragenlijst GI Voorstel_Ondertekend.pdf document in Insurance_Documents table by re-extracting text from the downloaded PDF and updating the parsed_content and status fields in Supabase.
Submits the Legal Agent audit response to Supabase Agent_Audit_Status table and pushes the agent briefing to GitHub.

Load only binding legal contracts: SHA, term sheets, SAFEs, loan agreements, ESOPs, founder agreements, CLAs, board resolutions, subsidy contracts, tax compliance docs
No duplicates — always check existing records before inserting new ones
